38:72: Mi t Mesleɣ, Suḍeɣ degs, si ṛṛuḥ iW, ṭinzemt ɣuṛes, s lekni".
38:74: siwa Iblis i izuxxen, illa seg ijehliyen.
38:75: Inna: "A Iblis, w ik igedlen lekni i win Xelqeɣ s ifassen iW? Tzuxxeḍ, neɣ telliḍ seg wid iufraren"?
38:76: Inna: "Nek ifeɣ t. Txelqeḍ iyi si tmes, Txelqeḍ t si talaxt".
38:79: Inna: "A Mass iw, eoo iyi ar ass ideg ara d kkren".
38:82: Inna: "s tezmert iK, a ten ɣewwuɣ, akken ma llan,
38:85: Ad Acareɣ Loahennama yissek, akked wid, segsen, i k iḍefṛen, akken ma llan".
38:86: Ini: "ur awen ssutreɣ taqdiɛt af waya. Ur lliɣ, nek, seg wid iţţestaɛmilen".
38:87: Neţţa, s tideţ, d asmekti kan i imaḍalen.
38:88: Mi tɛadda tallit, war ccekk, a kwen id iaweḍ usali s.
39:1: Tarusi n Tezmamt sɣuṛ Ṛebbi, Uzmir, Bab n ṣṣwab.
39:2: Ih, Nessader ak d Tazmamt, s tideţ. Ihi, aɛbed Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Neţţa.
39:3: Day mačči i Ṛebbi laɛqida? Wid iţţaddamen imawlan, war Neţţa, nnan: "naɛbed iten kan, iwakken ad aɣ rnun aseqṛeb ar Ṛebbi". Ih, Ṛebbi ad Iḥudd garasen, ɣef wayen iɣef mgarraden. Ṛebbi, war ccekk, ur Inehhu win illan d akeddab, d ajehli.
39:4: Lemmer Ibɣi Ṛebbi ad Isɛu aqcic, yili Ifren, deg wayen Ixelleq, ayen i S ihwan. Gedha s yiS! Neţţa d Ṛebbi Yiwen, Aqehhaṛ.
39:5: Ixleq tamurt akked igenwan, s tideţ. Inneḍ Iḍ i wass, Inneḍ ass i yiḍ. Iḥeţţem i yiṭij akked waggur, ad lḥun, yal wa, ar lajel iţwassnen. Day Neţţa mačči d Uzmir Iţsemmiḥen?
39:6: Ixelq ikwen si yiwen n lxelq. Irra, segs, tislit is. Issers awen d ṭam n tyugiwin n lmal. Ixelq ikwen di tɛabbuḍin n tyimmatin nnwen, lxelq deffir lxelq, di kraḍ n tellisat. D wagi ay d Ṛebbi, Mass nnwen. IneS tagelda, ur illi ṛebbi siwa Neţţa. Amek ihi tugim?
39:7: Ma tjehlem, Ṛebbi ur kwen Iḥwao ara. Ur Iţṛadi tijehli i imdanen iS. Ma tesnemmrem, a kwen Iṛaḍi. Ur iţbibbi yiwen taɛkkwemt n wayeḍ; sinna, ar Mass nnwen tuɣalin nnwen; ad awen Imel acu txeddmem. Ih, Neţţa, Issen i illan deg idmaren.
39:8: Amdan, ma iḥuza t ccqa, ad inuj ar Mass is, d ucɛif ɣuṛes; sinna, ma Iɣat it sɣuṛeS, ad iţţu ayen iɣef inuj ɣuṛeS, uqbel; ad irr i Ṛebbi tanudda, ad innetlaf seg ubrid iS. Ini: "zzhu cwiṭ di tijehli k, ihi, kečč seg wat tmes".
39:9: Day win iţţanzen deg iḍ, ikna u ibedd, iţḥebbiṛ i laxeṛt, issaram aḥunu n Mass is…? Ini: "day ɛadlen wid issnen akked wid ur nessin? Ay d ismektayen, kan, d uɛqilen".
39:10: Ini: "a yimdanen iW iumnen, ḥezzbet i Mass nnwen. Ayen ilhan i wid imaɛnen di ddunit agi. Tamurt n Ṛebbi tewsaɛ. Ihi, arraz, war aktili, ad iţţunefk i iṣebṛiyen".
39:11: Ini: "nek ţwamṛeɣ d ad ɛabdeɣ Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Neţţa.
39:12: Pwamṛeɣ d, ad iliɣ d amḍuɛ amenzu".
39:13: Ini: "nek, ugadeɣ, ma aɛṣaɣ Mass iw, aɛaqeb n wass ameqwṛaḥan".
39:14: Ini: "ad ɛabdeɣ Ṛebbi, s laɛqida i Neţţa.
39:15: Ihi, ɛabdet i wen ihwan, war Neţţa". Ini: "imexsuṛen d wid iwedṛen iman nnsen, akked twacult nnsen, ass n tnekra". Niɣ d tagi ay d taxessaṛt n ṣṣeḥ.
39:16: Aɣembabu n tmes, sennig sen, wayeḍ seddawat sen. Ayagi, Issagwad yis Ṛebbi imdanen iS: a yimdanen iW, ḥezzbet iyI!
39:17: Wid ijunben aɛbad iṛebbiten n tkerkas, u iutuben Ṛebbi, a ten id ias lfeṛḥ. Ihi, ssefṛeḥ imdanen iW
39:18: i issemḥasen i wawal, teddun d ṣṣam ines. D wigi i Inha Ṛebbi, d wigi ay d uɛqilen.
39:19: Day win iɣef iţţuseyya ad isɛaddi aɛaqeb, day a ţsellkeḍ kečč, win illan di tmes?
39:20: Ma d wid iḥezzben i Mass nnsen, ad sɛun tiɣuṛfatin, bnant ta sennig ta, isaffen seddawat sent ţţazzalen, d lemɛahda n Ṛebbi. Ṛebbi ur Ixeṭṭu i lemɛahda.
39:21: Ur twalaḍ ara, Ṛebbi Isseɣli d aman, seg igenni, Issekcem iten ad sswen akal. Sinna, yissen, a d Issuffeɣ imɣan n yal ini, ara iuɣalen ad isliwen. A ten twaliḍ d iwṛaɣen, sinna, a ten Irr d iquṛanen. Deg waya, s tideţ, asmekti i uɛqilen.
39:22: Day win iwumi Illi Ṛebbi, idmaren is, ar wannuz, dɣa neţţa di tafat sɣuṛ Mass is…? A ssxeḍ n at wulawen iqquṛen, ur d smektayen Ṛebbi! Widak di ttelfan n ṣṣeḥ.
39:23: Issader ed Ṛebbi ṣṣam n wawal. Tazmamt, degs acbi, allus. Ad ccirwen segs igwelman akked wulawen n wid iţţagwaden Mass nnsen, sinna, igwelman akked wulawen nnsen ad iḥninen ar usmekti n Ṛebbi. D tagi ay d nnhaya n Ṛebbi. Inehhu yis, win i S ihwan. Win Itlef Ṛebbi, ur illi wa ara t inhun.
39:24: Day win iţḥezziben, s wudem is, seg uɛaqeb ucmit, ass n tnekra…? Ad inin i imednas: "jeṛṛbet ayen tkeţţbem"!
39:25: Skaddben wid i ten id izwaren. Iusa ten id uɛaqeb, seg wanda ur bnin.
39:26: Issukk fellasen Ṛebbi aɛaqeb, di tmeddurt n ddunit; war ccekk, aɛaqeb n laxeṛt iugar it, lemmer ẓeṛṛen!
39:27: Niɣ Nefka i imdanen, di Leqwṛan agi, yal amedya, amar a d mmektin.
39:28: Leqwṛan s taɛṛabt, ur degs tiɛɛawji; amar ad ḥezzben.
39:29: Ifka d Ṛebbi amedya n urgaz icerken akked wid iţmerẓan, u argaz di tifrat akked yiwen urgaz. Day ɛadlen sin imedyaten? Ccekṛan i Ṛebbi. Xaṭi, tegwti degsen ur ssinen.
39:30: War ccekk, kečč a ţţemmteḍ, nitni ad mmten.
39:31: Sinna, kunwi, ass n tnekra, ar Mass nnwen, a ţţemqellaɛm.
